notes: Requested replication eta squared is not printed for the item-length correlation: retain printed r without conversion. Original additionally prints r2 = 0.74. Replication additionally prints R2 = 0.76 for this correlation. Syntactic complexity in original is descriptive (items 11 vs 12); no separate p/ES is printed there. Replication reports a distinct multiple regression of item difficulty on syllable length and attributive-clause presence, F(2, 27)=50.97, p < .001, R2 = 79.1 (as printed), Table 7 preprint p. 23; this is not an eta-squared estimate and not pooled with the correlation. Table 7 prints syllable-length t=-8.83, p<0.001 and attributive-clause t=-2.13, p=0.04. Supplied replication p. 10 differs from preprint pagination. Quotes normalize PDF glyphs/whitespace.
